Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity native iOS/iPadOS UI design proposal for Weavelet Canvas, a branching AI conversation workspace. This is a design review board, not advertising. Flat front-facing screenshots, no perspective, no photographed devices, no decorative gradients. Dark slate UI inspired by the user's reference: background #343541, panels #3d3e49, subtle gray outlines, off-white Japanese system typography, restrained teal/blue accents. Crisp readable controls, generous native touch spacing. Preserve Web's structure and operation locations. Crucial bubble header: avatar and role selector on left, on right TWO separate capsules: first current display mode text '原文' plus down chevron, second exactly three distinct icons: checkmark rosette for evaluation, slashed eye for omit, outline shield for protect. Second group is NOT segmented selection. No font-size controls. Use short accurate Japanese text, no invented functionality. Text and message content may be illustrative. Consistent visual language across the board. Reference image is visual guidance for the bubble header only, not an edit target.
Board 01, title '01 全体レイアウト'. Landscape large design board. A large iPad landscape app on left (about 75% width) and a narrower iPhone app on right (25%). Labels 'iPad・通常幅' and 'iPhone・狭幅'. iPad left sidebar: Weavelet Canvas, new conversation, search, two folders and four conversation titles; bottom entries '同期', '設定', '入出力'. Main upper toolbar: model selector, back/forward, search, right-aligned 'チャット / 分岐' view controls and layout menu. Below, left pane is readable conversation with one short user and one assistant message and input at bottom; right pane branching graph with 5 connected rounded rectangular nodes, undo/redo and zoom/fit bottom left, minimap bottom right. Both panes have useful width. iPhone shows single chat with same top toolbar roles, sidebar opener left, view switch right, two messages, bottom input. On narrow bubble header place role first row and TWO capsules right-aligned on second row, never shrink into same row. No bottom tab bar. Minimal annotation at board bottom: '操作位置を維持し、幅に応じて再配置'.

Board 02, title '02 チャットビュー詳細'. Landscape large design board showing a medium-width tablet chat pane on left 60%, a full iPhone chat pane on right 35%. Labels '通常幅' and '狭幅'. Native-looking toolbar across top of each: sidebar opener, conversation title '設計の相談', model selector 'モデル', search, view switch at right. Main view contains user message '共通化する範囲を整理してください。' and assistant message with exact readable short content '仕様と検証データを共通化します。\n通信・保存・描画は各環境に合わせます。' Assistant header has exact TWO capsules as reference, readable '原文 ⌄' followed by evaluation/omit/protect icons. Tablet headers one row; iPhone avatar/role first row, capsules second row aligned right. Message footer: branch selection '1 / 3' left, regenerate/copy/edit icons in central capsule, more menu right. Keep primary actions directly visible, no giant arrays of icons. Input dock bottom: plus left, Japanese placeholder 'メッセージを入力', send arrow right. Show enough bottom safe area. Small note '役割・表示・操作を同じ領域内で整理'. No floating unrelated controls, no invented font control.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity native iOS/iPadOS UI design proposal for Weavelet Canvas, a branching AI conversation workspace. This is a design review board, not advertising. Flat front-facing screenshots, no perspective, no photographed devices, no decorative gradients. Dark slate UI inspired by the user's reference: background #343541, panels #3d3e49, subtle gray outlines, off-white Japanese system typography, restrained teal/blue accents. Crisp readable controls, generous native touch spacing. Preserve Web's structure and operation locations. Crucial bubble header: avatar and role selector on left, on right TWO separate capsules: first current display mode text '原文' plus down chevron, second exactly three distinct icons: checkmark rosette for evaluation, slashed eye for omit, outline shield for protect. Second group is NOT segmented selection. No font-size controls. Use short accurate Japanese text, no invented functionality. Text and message content may be illustrative. Consistent visual language across the board. Reference image is visual guidance for the bubble header only, not an edit target.
Board 03, title '03 バブル詳細'. Landscape large design specification board with three clearly separated panels, no device frames. Top left wide panel labeled '通常幅': enlarged assistant bubble with avatar and 'アシスタント ⌄' at left and exact two right-aligned capsules '原文 ⌄' and three evaluation/omit/protect icons. Rounded content surface below with two readable text lines. Footer has left '1 / 3', central regenerate/copy/edit, right more. Top right narrow panel labeled '狭幅': same bubble, role on first row, TWO capsules on next row aligned right, body below, footer wrap into two rows without reducing button sizes. Bottom wide panel labeled '編集中': same message context with native multiline text editor, footer two distinct groups '保存 ⌄' and '生成 ⌄', separate 'キャンセル'. Do not equate reading mode selection with editing. Concise annotation lines below panels: '表示形式は選択メニュー', '評価は操作、除外・保護は独立した状態', '狭い幅では段を増やし、縮小しない'. Connect one thin annotation line to each of the two header capsule groups, avoid overlapping annotations and interface. This image should make spacing and grouping easy to judge.
targetedEdits: Edit this UI design board. Keep colors, sidebar, split graph, dimensions, Japanese typography and overall layout. Correct toolbar vs message controls. Top app toolbar model selector should say 'モデル' NOT 'アシスタント'. On the right iPhone REMOVE the standalone assistant role and two capsule rows from above the conversation title. Instead attach the assistant avatar + role dropdown and TWO capsules directly above the ASSISTANT reply content, AFTER the user message. For iPhone use two rows inside the assistant message header: avatar + 'アシスタント' first row; second row right aligned '原文 ⌄' capsule then a distinct capsule with exactly evaluation badge, slashed eye, shield. Shorten sample assistant prose to make space rather than shrink controls. On iPad chat pane also place these two capsules inside assistant message header immediately above reply, wrapping header onto two rows as necessary. A user message must appear before assistant header; headers belong to their own message, not the app. No role selector or original-text/omit/protect controls in app toolbar. Replace top marketing tagline with 'デザイン案'. Keep remaining structure. Preserve useful native touch spacing.

Edit this UI design board, change only the incorrect message order in right-hand iPhone panel. Keep left tablet panel exactly unchanged, style/color/title/labels/controls unchanged. On the iPhone, immediately below app navigation toolbar, place the user bubble '共通化する範囲を整理してください。' first. Then BELOW that user bubble and its timestamp place assistant header: avatar and 'アシスタント ⌄' first row; second row right-aligned '原文 ⌄' capsule followed by the separate evaluation/slashed-eye/shield capsule. Then directly below that header place assistant reply '仕様と検証データを共通化します。通信・保存・描画は各環境に合わせます。', followed by timestamp and footer actions. The assistant header MUST NOT be above the user message. Preserve bottom input, safe area, generous native touch sizes. Fit by reducing unused vertical gaps, not shrinking controls.
